svg.title: One reading, three possible sources
svg.desc: The source is one of three symbolic states: (1,0,0), (1,0,1), (1,0,2). The reading E keeps the first two coordinates, giving (1,0) in all three cases. It determines the visible pair, but not the hidden value. SwapVisible exchanges the first two coordinates and retains the third: the full outputs still differ, but all have visible pair (0,1). Starting from the original states, ExposeHidden instead maps (alpha,beta,r) to (r,0,0), giving three different visible pairs. The original reading alone cannot determine this new answer.

g.aria-label: The source is one of these three symbolic cases. All give the reading (1, 0).
g.data-vi-text: The source is one of these three symbolic cases. All give the reading (1, 0).

g.aria-label: We do not know which one is present.
g.data-vi-text: We do not know which one is present.

g.aria-label: Only the third coordinate, r, differs. It is hidden from this reading.
g.data-vi-text: Only the third coordinate, r, differs. It is hidden from this reading.

g.aria-label: One operation, the same visible result
g.data-vi-text: One operation, the same visible result

g.aria-label: SwapVisible exchanges the first two coordinates and keeps the hidden one.
g.data-vi-text: SwapVisible exchanges the first two coordinates and keeps the hidden one.

g.aria-label: The full states still differ. The visible pair is (0, 1) in every case.
g.data-vi-text: The full states still differ. The visible pair is (0, 1) in every case.

g.aria-label: The new reading follows by swapping the old pair: (1, 0) → (0, 1).
g.data-vi-text: The new reading follows by swapping the old pair: (1, 0) → (0, 1).

g.aria-label: A different operation makes the hidden value matter
g.data-vi-text: A different operation makes the hidden value matter

g.aria-label: From the same original states, ExposeHidden puts r in the visible pair.
g.data-vi-text: From the same original states, ExposeHidden puts r in the visible pair.

g.aria-label: The old reading (1, 0) alone cannot tell us which new pair results.
g.data-vi-text: The old reading (1, 0) alone cannot tell us which new pair results.

g.aria-label: For this new answer, we need an observation that distinguishes these cases.
g.data-vi-text: For this new answer, we need an observation that distinguishes these cases.
